mapper.sql: select cargo_id, order_id, cargo_name, cargo_type, quantity, unit, weight, vehicle_type, vehicle_length, vehicle_count from tms_order_cargo
mapper.select: where order_id = #{orderId} and is_del = '0' order by cargo_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into tms_order_cargo( order_id, cargo_name, cargo_type, quantity, unit, weight, vehicle_type, vehicle_length, vehicle_count, is_del, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time )values( #{orderId}, #{cargoName}, #{cargoType}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{weight}, #{vehicleType}, #{vehicleLength}, #{vehicleCount}, '0', #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )

insert into tms_order_cargo( order_id, cargo_name, cargo_type, quantity, unit, weight, vehicle_type, vehicle_length, vehicle_count, is_del, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time ) values

update.foreach: update tms_order_cargo set cargo_name = #{item.cargoName}, cargo_type = #{item.cargoType}, quantity = #{item.quantity}, unit = #{item.unit}, weight = #{item.weight}, vehicle_type = #{item.vehicleType}, vehicle_length = #{item.vehicleLength}, vehicle_count = #{item.vehicleCount}, update_by = #{item.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where cargo_id = #{item.cargoId} and is_del = '0'

mapper.update: update tms_order_cargo set is_del = '1', update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
